exceptions.reason: TitleTooltips (src/components/TitleTooltips.tsx) shows these elements' title or aria-label as a role=tooltip bubble on hover and keyboard focus, and mounts it only while shown. tests/ui/tooltips.ui.ts checks that it appears.

Items in menus (rows, and the track menu's icon row and footer) and lists, and segments of a segmented control, sit edge to edge as one composite control. Each target is at least 24px, which WCAG 2.5.8 accepts without spacing.

exceptions.reason: Titles, names and secondary lines that truncate to one line with an ellipsis by design (text-overflow: ellipsis in their CSS). Replay's most played track keeps two lines of its title (-webkit-line-clamp), so its tile never outgrows the cover; both carry the full text in a title tooltip.
Visually hidden text for screen readers is clipped on purpose.
Synced lyrics fade the lines and words that aren't being sung, so the current one stands out; it is drawn in full --foreground. A design choice, not a measurement gap.
The command palette's ↵ ↑ ↓ key glyphs, which axe skips as non-text. --muted-foreground on --muted measures 5.9:1 in both themes.
Cards show their title as text. At phone width a card whose title is below the fold looks text-free to the check.
